method.fixtures: Clones of one schema50 database; same 3 demo branches, 30 menu products, 5 categories, 6 banners, same 36 WebP files in dedicated local MinIO. After clone migrated to schema53.
method.browser: Chromium headless, 390x844, ru-RU, Europe/Moscow; 10/2 Mbit, CDP latency80ms; SW blocked. Production client builds, identical env-config.js to localhost4000.
method.sequence: before-a, after-a, after-b, before-b; 7 fresh contexts per block, then same-context reload; backend restarted and one excluded warmup per block.
method.menu_timing: Navigation start until first real product card visible; not full image completion or interactivity. Standard median across 14 samples per mode/revision.
method.capture_window: Additional 2500ms after menu visible for API/resource counts; not total bytes for all subsequent browsing.
method.server: Same loopback ports3000/4000, PostgreSQL17 localhost55439, MinIO18333; ERL_FLAGS=+S 4:4; reload/watchers off, warning logging, Oban manual; storefront revision polling remains enabled.
method.load: Warm API replay:100 scenarios,5 visitors, no browser/network throttling. BEAM CPU only, PostgreSQL/browser/S3 CPU not measured. Two successful before samples and three after samples.
method.excluded: Initial env-config404 exploratory timing discarded and recaptured after HTTP200. Third consecutive initial before load got429, excluded; rate limiter not disabled. User stopped further measurement before a replacement third before sample.

resource_anomaly.finding: Current reload fetches new image URLs; not repeated transfer of the cached cold URLs. Hydration/native lazy loading cause is a hypothesis, not proven. No source fix in measurement task.
